name: Bear Crawl
steps: Start on all fours on the floor with your wrists directly under your shoulders, knees beneath your hips, and toes tucked under.
Brace your abs firmly and hover both knees just a couple of inches off the floor with a flat back.
Step one hand forward together with the opposite foot while keeping your hips low and level.
Continue crawling forward with alternating opposite hand-and-foot steps for the target duration, then lower your knees gently.
tips: Take short, crisp steps so your hips stay level without swaying side to side.
Keep your knees hovering low near the floor rather than piking your hips upward.
